noteText: Morning handoff: the loading door was stuck and volunteers waited in the rain. Received 20 bags of rice from the morning delivery. The kettle was broken, so we moved the tea break. Distributed 6 bags of rice to visitors. The clipboard went missing and was found under the desk. Two damaged bags of rice were set aside in quarantine. At closing, the physical shelf count was 12 bags of rice. We swept the floor, checked the lights, and locked the loading door. Priya needs to recount the rice tomorrow. This note does not establish an opening balance. There was a conversation about next month's rota, but no schedule was agreed.
